body:
Addressed: No fixes were applied. The merge reached the required stop condition.

There are no reviews or pre-review comments on head `4acc5ec0e3d794d42e0ecab4e9017332ad8507f0`.

I attempted to merge upstream main `db3bb1f7f3c47cf3561a8e9534f4f2cde260cba8`. Both branches change the same logic:

- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`, `run_job_arms`, conflict lines 326–354: the PR routes Chamfer selections and refuses Boundary settings for open chamfer runs. Main changes the same `contour_sel_arm` predicate to include sketch contours.
- `crates/app/src/operation/job.rs`, `collect_job`, conflict lines 269–312 and 324–341: the PR excludes Chamfer selections from region generation. Main adds sketch contour and slot routing, Waterjet selections, and sketch guards in the same dispatch.

The requested conflict rule requires a stop when both branches change the same logic. I aborted the merge. The worktree is clean at the original head. No commit or push occurred. The warm worktree remains at `.claude/worktrees/fix-3251`.

Quick gate, heavy gate, catalog tests, mutation checks, and clippy did not run. No fix exists to test. Re-review remains blocked by these conflict hunks.

Thank you, @paulrobin. You are welcome to continue on this branch.
